description.en: An embedded panel that follows your pointer and settles with an interruptible spring.
description.zh: 嵌入页面的拖动面板。跟随手势，松手后弹簧回位，途中可再次抓住。

source.attribution: Original local skill-samples reading panel, 2026-09-08; modularized for Design parts. Not an Apple component.
source.materials: No third-party images, fonts or network assets.

summary.en: Original local skill-samples reading panel, retaining the gesture parameters in an independent module. Not an Apple component; no third-party images, fonts or network assets.
summary.zh: 来源：原有 skill-samples 跟手阅读面板，保留机制参数并提炼为独立模块。不是 Apple 官方组件；不含第三方图片、字体或网络素材。

summary.en: The pointer controls position directly. Release to settle at one of two resting positions. Grab the handle again to interrupt the spring.
summary.zh: 拖动时直接跟手。松手后，根据位置与速度选择停靠点。回弹途中重新抓住横条，即可打断弹簧。

fit.en: A reading or detail panel contained within a page region, with two resting positions.
fit.zh: 页面区域内的阅读或详情面板，具有展开和收起两个停靠位置。

avoid.en: Not a modal dialog. No focus trap or page scroll lock. No React/Vue adapter or real-phone certification.
avoid.zh: 不是模态弹层，不提供焦点约束或页面滚动锁定；没有 React/Vue 适配，也未做真实手机验收。

integration.en: Start with example.html. Change content and CSS variables; call destroy() when removing the panel.
integration.zh: 从 example.html 开始。替换内容与 CSS 变量，移除面板时调用 destroy()。

accessibility.en: Keyboard actions switch immediately. System reduced motion is respected. Collapsed content is not focusable.
accessibility.zh: 键盘操作即时切换。尊重系统的减少动态效果设置。收起的正文不可聚焦。

usage.requirements: Modern browsers with ES modules, Pointer Events, ResizeObserver and inert. Serve examples over HTTP, not file://.
